column3: “People of Israel” is rendered “sons of Israel,” and “covenant loyalty” “kindness.”
“They have broken out” is rendered “They employ violence”; “bloods touch bloods” is rendered “bloodshed follows bloodshed.”
“Bring a case” is rendered “find fault”; “those who contend with a priest” is rendered with “the priest.” The meaning is uncertain.
“The day” is rendered “by day”; “night” is rendered “by night.”
“From serving as a priest to me” is rendered “from being My priest”; NASB renders “because” as “Since.”
“I will exchange their glory for shame” is rendered “I will change their glory into shame.”
“Eat” is rendered “feed on”; “lift up its desire” is rendered “direct their desire.”
“They have forsaken the LORD to keep” is rendered “they have stopped giving heed to the LORD.”
“His wood” is rendered “their wooden idol,” and “his stick” “their diviner’s wand”; “from under their God” is rendered “departing from their God.”
“They themselves” is rendered “the men themselves,” and “cult prostitutes” “temple prostitutes.”
“Do not swear” is rendered “And take the oath,” carrying over the earlier negative; NASB adds the quotation “As the LORD lives!”
NASB renders the second clause as a question: “Can the LORD now pasture them … ?”; “roomy place” is rendered “large field.”
“Leave him alone” is rendered “Let him alone.”
“Drink has come to an end” is rendered “Their liquor gone,” and “her shields” “Their rulers”; “love, love” is rendered “dearly love.” The meaning is uncertain.
“It has wrapped” is rendered “The wind wraps them”; “it” is rendered “them.”
